definitions.explanation: A mathematical relationship where one quantity increases as another decreases at a proportional rate. Also used figuratively to describe opposing trends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反比例|はんぴれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Speed and time are inversely proportional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反比例|はんぴれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Income and free time are in an inverse relationship.

examples.japanese: {反比例|はんぴれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{双曲線|そうきょくせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The graph of an inverse proportion forms a hyperbola.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to mean "to be inversely proportional." Taught in middle school mathematics. Also used loosely in everyday language to describe any situation where two things move in opposite directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反比例|はんぴれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be inversely proportional)
- {反比例|はんぴれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (inverse relationship)
- {反比例|はんぴれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (inverse proportion graph)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{比例|ひれい}→比例：13215_hirei⟧: proportion — a direct proportional relationship where both quantities increase together
